method: ELF file offsets mapped using GNU readelf PT_LOAD; every target sampled address sent to platform LLVM symbolizer. Leaf-Line=0 addresses grouped by root function and independently matched to consecutive raw llvm-dwarfdump --debug-line rows within each sequence. PLT is excluded because it is not in_func_no_line. Counts reconcile exactly with six formal reports. GNU addr2line probes provide a second reader.
